examples.en: Please answer my question.
Can you answer in English?
She did not answer the phone.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：answer 音近「安瑟」，安瑟 answer 回答问题。
语义联想：把「回答」和英文 answer 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 answers；过去式 answered

examples.en: The Olympic Games began in Athens.
examples.zh: 奥林匹克运动会在雅典开始。

examples.en: Our class began the sports game together.
examples.zh: 我们班一起开始了体育比赛。

examples.en: The Winter Olympics began last year.
examples.zh: 冬季奥运会去年开始了。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The games began yesterday. began 是 begin 的过去式，开始了。

reveal.inflectionNote: begin 的过去式

examples.en: Asia is a big continent.
Asia is a continent in the world.
Athletes come from every continent.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：continent 音近「康提嫩特」，康提嫩特说 continent 大陆。
形象联想：想象 world map 上各大 continent 大陆。

examples.en: My dream is to join the Olympic team.
examples.zh: 我的梦想是加入奥运队。

examples.en: She has a dream about the world games.
examples.zh: 她有一个关于世界比赛的美梦。

examples.en: Work hard and follow your dream.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 dream 加入 Olympic team 奥运队。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 dreams；过去式 dreamed/dreamt

examples.en: Our team won the game.
The sports game is exciting.
Let us play a ball game together.
examples.zh: 我们一起玩球类游戏吧。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Our team won the game. game 是比赛、游戏。

examples.en: China will hold the Summer Olympics again.
examples.zh: 中国将再次举办夏季奥运会。

examples.en: They hold the games every four years.
examples.zh: 他们每四年举办一次运动会。

examples.en: Our school will hold a sports day.
examples.zh: 我们学校将举办运动会。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：China will hold the games. hold 是举办。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 holds；过去式 held

examples.en: The Olympic Games bring the world together.
examples.zh: 奥林匹克运动会让世界相聚。

examples.en: I watch the Olympic Games on TV.
examples.zh: 我在电视上看奥林匹克运动会。

examples.en: The Olympic Games have five rings.
examples.zh: 奥林匹克运动会有五环。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Olympic 奥林匹克的 + Games 运动会，Olympic Games 是奥林匹克运动会。

examples.en: There is one ring in the Olympic logo.
The gold ring is on her finger.
examples.zh: 金戒指戴在她的手指上。

examples.en: We made a ring of flowers.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 Olympic 五环 five rings。

examples.en: One world, one dream is a famous slogan.
examples.zh: 「同一个世界，同一个梦想」是著名口号。

examples.en: Our class made a slogan for Sports Day.
examples.zh: 我们班为运动会想了一句口号。

examples.en: Read the slogan on the poster.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Read the slogan on the poster. slogan 是口号。

examples.en: I want something to drink.
Tell me something about the Olympics.
examples.zh: 告诉我一些关于奥运会的事。

examples.en: There is something on the floor.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I want something to drink. something 是某事物。

examples.en: He is strong and healthy.
Exercise makes you strong.
Our team is very strong.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：strong 音近「斯壮」，斯壮 feel strong 强壮。
语义联想：He is strong and healthy. strong 是强壮的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 stronger；最高级 strongest

examples.en: The Summer Olympics take place in summer.
examples.zh: 夏季奥运会在夏天举行。

examples.en: She watches the Summer Olympics every time.
examples.zh: 她每次都会看夏季奥运会。

examples.en: Swimming is my favorite Summer Olympics sport.
examples.zh: 游泳是我最喜欢的夏季奥运项目。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Summer 夏季 + Olympics 奥运会，Summer Olympics 是夏季奥运会。

examples.en: The games will take place in Paris.
When will the sports day take place?
The Olympic Games take place every four years.
examples.zh: 奥运会每四年举行一次。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：take 进行 + place 地方，take place 是举行。

examples.en: We cheer for our team together.
Let us exercise together after school.
examples.zh: 放学后我们一起锻炼吧。

examples.en: The world comes together for the Olympics.
examples.zh: 世界因奥运会相聚在一起。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：together 音近「图盖泽」，图盖泽 work together 一起。
语义联想：We cheer together. together 是一起。

examples.en: The Winter Olympics are held in cold places.
examples.zh: 冬季奥运会在寒冷地区举办。

examples.en: Ice hockey is popular at the Winter Olympics.
examples.zh: 冰球是冬季奥运会的热门项目。

examples.en: My brother loves the Winter Olympics.
examples.zh: 我哥哥喜欢冬季奥运会。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Winter 冬季 + Olympics 奥运会，Winter Olympics 是冬季奥运会。

examples.en: Athletes from all over the world came here.
examples.zh: 来自世界各地的运动员来到这里。

examples.en: The Olympic Games are famous around the world.
examples.zh: 奥运会在全世界都很有名。

examples.en: We want peace in the world.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：world 音近「沃尔德」，沃尔德说 world 世界。
语义联想：把「世界」和英文 world 配对记忆。

examples.en: I always exercise in the morning.
She always passes the ball to her team.
We should always keep healthy.
examples.zh: 我们应该始终保持健康。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I always exercise. always 是总是。

examples.en: Catch the ball!
Pass the ball to me.
The ball is between two players.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 catch the ball 双手接球。

examples.en: Stand between Tom and me.
The ball is between the two boys.
Choose between these two teams.
examples.zh: 在这两支队之间选一支。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：between 音近「比图因」，比图因 stand between 站在中间。
语义联想：把「在……（两者）之间」和英文 between 配对记忆。

examples.en: Catch the ball with both hands.
Can you catch it?
The boy can catch the ball and cheer.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：catch 音近「凯奇」，凯奇 catch 接住球。
语义联想：把「接住」和英文 catch 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 catches；过去式 caught

examples.en: Cheer for our team!
The students cheer loudly.
We cheer when our team scores.
examples.zh: 我们队得分时我们欢呼。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cheer 音近「起儿」，起儿 cheer 欢呼加油。
语义联想：把「欢呼」和英文 cheer 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 cheers；过去式 cheered

examples.en: Do not cry. Try again.
The fans cry with joy.
I heard someone cry for help.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Don't cry. cry 是哭、喊叫。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 cries；过去式 cried

examples.en: Exercise every day to stay healthy.
We exercise on the playground.
Running is good exercise.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：exercise 音近「艾克赛赛兹」，艾克赛赛兹 exercise 锻炼。
语义联想：把「锻炼」和英文 exercise 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 exercises；过去式 exercised

examples.en: Eat healthy food every day.
Exercise keeps you healthy.
She looks strong and healthy.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：healthy 音近「海尔西」，海尔西 keep healthy 保持健康。
语义联想：看到「健康的」的事物时，就想到 healthy。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 healthier；最高级 healthiest

examples.en: I often play ball after school.
We often exercise together.
How often do you pass the ball?

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I often exercise. often 是经常。

examples.en: Pass the ball to your teammate.
Please pass me the ball.
He can pass well in the game.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：pass 音近「帕斯」，帕斯 pass 传球。
语义联想：把「传递」和英文 pass 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 passes；过去式 passed

examples.en: Sometimes we play in the rain.
I sometimes exercise at home.
Their team sometimes wins.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Sometimes we play ball. sometimes 是有时。

examples.en: Our team won the game.
She is on the school team.
Every team needs strong players.
examples.zh: 每支队都需要强壮的队员。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：team 音近「提姆」，提姆在 team 队里。
语义联想：把「（体育的）队」和英文 team 配对记忆。

examples.en: Their team is very strong.
The players put on their caps.
examples.zh: 队员们戴上他们的帽子。

examples.en: Their coach is a woman.
examples.zh: 他们的教练是一位妇女。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Their team is strong. their 是他们的。

examples.en: The woman is our PE teacher.
examples.zh: 这位妇女是我们的体育老师。

examples.en: A strong woman joined our team.
examples.zh: 一位强壮的妇女加入了我们队。

examples.en: That woman can catch the ball well.
examples.zh: 那位妇女接球接得很好。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The woman is our PE teacher. woman 是妇女。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 women（不规则变化）

examples.en: Do you have any candy?
Is there any salad on the menu?
You can choose any food you like.
examples.zh: 你可以选择任何喜欢的食物。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Do you have any candy? any 是任何的。

examples.en: Too much candy is bad for your teeth.
Bad food is not delicious.
Do not eat bad fruit.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Candy is bad for teeth. bad 是坏的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 worse；最高级 worst

examples.en: Put the fruit in the basket.
There is a basket of apples.
Bring a basket to the picnic.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：basket 音近「巴斯克特」，巴斯克特提 basket 篮子。
语义联想：把「篮」和英文 basket 配对记忆。

examples.en: Exercise is good for your body.
examples.zh: 锻炼对你的身体有好处。

examples.en: Keep your body healthy.
Wash your body every day.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Exercise is good for your body. body 是身体。

examples.en: Bring some food to the party.
Please bring a glass of water.
She will bring salad for lunch.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Bring some food. bring 是带来。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 brings；过去式 brought

examples.en: Too much candy is bad for teeth.
Do not eat candy before bed.
The candy is sweet and delicious.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 candy 糖果 bad for teeth 对牙不好。

examples.en: The soup is delicious.
We had delicious food at lunch.
examples.zh: 我们午餐吃了美味的食物。

examples.en: This salad looks delicious.
examples.zh: 这份色拉看起来很好吃。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：delicious 音近「地里舍斯」，地里舍斯说 delicious 美味。
语义联想：看到「美味的」的事物时，就想到 delicious。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 more delicious

examples.en: Healthy food is good for you.
examples.zh: 健康的食物对你有好处。

examples.en: What food is on the menu?
Bring some food to school.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 menu 上的 healthy food 健康食物。

examples.en: A glass of water, please.
The glass is on the table.
Fill the glass with juice.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：glass 音近「格拉斯」，格拉斯拿 glass 玻璃杯。
语义联想：把「玻璃杯」和英文 glass 配对记忆。

examples.en: Brush your teeth to keep them clean.
Keep healthy with good food.
Keep the food in the box.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Brush your teeth to keep them clean. keep 是保持。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 keeps；过去式 kept

examples.en: Look at the menu, please.
The menu has salad and soup.
What do you want from the menu?

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：menu 音近「麦纽」，麦纽看 menu 菜单。
语义联想：把「菜单」和英文 menu 配对记忆。

examples.en: I have a problem with my teeth.
Too much candy can be a problem.
Tell the dentist your problem.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：problem 音近「普罗布勒姆」，普罗布勒姆说 problem 问题。
语义联想：把「问题」和英文 problem 配对记忆。

examples.en: I usually eat salad for lunch.
The salad is fresh and delicious.
Would you like some salad?

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：salad 音近「萨拉德」，萨拉德吃 salad 色拉。
语义联想：把「色拉」和英文 salad 配对记忆。

examples.en: Brush your teeth twice a day.
Candy is bad for your teeth.
Keep your teeth clean and healthy.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 brush teeth 刷牙 keep 牙齿 clean。

reveal.inflectionNote: tooth 的复数形式

examples.en: I usually eat healthy food.
We usually bring lunch to school.
examples.zh: 我们通常带午饭到学校。

examples.en: She usually drinks a glass of water.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I usually eat salad. usually 是通常。

examples.en: This TV show is boring.
Shopping is not boring for my mother.
examples.zh: 购物对我妈妈来说并不无聊。

examples.en: The old clothes look boring.
examples.zh: 这些旧衣服看起来很单调。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：boring 音近「波灵」，波灵觉得 boring 很无聊。
语义联想：看到「乏味的」的事物时，就想到 boring。

examples.en: Put on your cap, please.
He wears a red cap.
I bought a new cap yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天买了一顶新帽子。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cap 音近「凯普」，凯普戴 cap 帽子。
语义联想：把「帽子」和英文 cap 配对记忆。

examples.en: These clothes are too small.
Put on clean clothes.
We need new clothes for winter.
examples.zh: 我们需要过冬的新衣服。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Put on clean clothes. clothes 是衣服。

examples.en: My daughter loves this dress.
examples.zh: 我女儿喜欢这条连衣裙。

examples.en: She goes shopping with her daughter.
The daughter tries on a pair of shorts.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：daughter 音近「道特」，道特是 daughter 女儿。
语义联想：把「女儿」和英文 daughter 配对记忆。

examples.en: She wears a beautiful dress.
examples.zh: 她穿着一条漂亮的连衣裙。

examples.en: This dress is too long.
My daughter wants a new dress.
examples.zh: 我女儿想要一条新连衣裙。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：dress 音近「德瑞斯」，德瑞斯穿 dress 连衣裙。
语义联想：把「女式连衣裙」和英文 dress 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 dresses；过去式 dressed

examples.en: Let us go shopping this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们今天下午去购物吧。

examples.en: Mother and I go shopping on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我和妈妈星期天去购物。

examples.en: We go shopping for new clothes.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 去 + shopping 购物，go shopping 是购物。

examples.en: I need a pair of trousers.
She bought a pair of shorts.
This pair of socks is clean.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：pair 音近「佩尔」，佩尔买 pair 一双。
语义联想：把「一双」和英文 pair 配对记忆。

examples.en: He wears shorts in summer.
Try on these shorts, please.
A pair of shorts is on the bed.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：shorts 音近「绍茨」，绍茨穿 shorts 短裤。
语义联想：把「短裤」和英文 shorts 配对记忆。

examples.en: My son likes this cap.
Her son goes shopping with her.
examples.zh: 她儿子和她一起去购物。

examples.en: The son tries on the trousers.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：My son likes this cap. son 是儿子。

examples.en: These trousers are too long.
He needs a new pair of trousers.
Try on the blue trousers.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：trousers 音近「特劳泽斯」，特劳泽斯穿 trousers 裤子。
语义联想：把「裤子」和英文 trousers 配对记忆。

examples.en: Try it on before you buy it.
Can I try it on?
Try it on in the shop.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：try 试 + it on 穿上，try it on 是试穿。

examples.en: Cleaning my bedroom is a piece of cake.
examples.zh: 打扫卧室对我来说小菜一碟。

examples.en: The housework is a piece of cake for him.
Washing socks? A piece of cake!

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：a piece 一块 + cake 蛋糕，a piece of cake 是小菜一碟。

examples.en: My bedroom is clean now.
There is a plant in my bedroom.
examples.zh: 我的卧室里有一盆植物。

examples.en: Please tidy your bedroom.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：bedroom 音近「贝德鲁姆」，贝德鲁姆在 bedroom 卧室。
形象联想：想象 tidy bedroom 整理卧室。

examples.en: Put the socks in the box.
The box is on the floor.
There are dirty clothes in the box.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：box 音近「博克斯」，博克斯放 box 盒子。
语义联想：把「盒子」和英文 box 配对记忆。

examples.en: These socks are dirty.
Wash the dirty clothes, please.
The floor is dirty. Let us clean it.
examples.zh: 地板脏了。我们来打扫吧。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 dirty socks 脏袜子放进 washing machine。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 dirtier；最高级 dirtiest

examples.en: Sweep the floor, please.
There is water on the floor.
The bedroom floor is clean.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：floor 音近「弗洛尔」，弗洛尔扫 floor 地板。
语义联想：把「地板」和英文 floor 配对记忆。

examples.en: I help my mother with housework.
Housework is not easy.
We do housework on Saturday.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 do housework 扫地、洗衣、浇 plant。

examples.en: Water the plant every day.
There is a plant in the bedroom.
The plant needs sun and water.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：plant 音近「普兰特」，普兰特浇 plant 植物。
形象联想：想象 water the plant 给植物浇水。

examples.en: I lost one sock.
Wash your dirty sock.
A sock is in the box.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：sock 音近「索克」，索克穿 sock 短袜。
语义联想：把「短袜」和英文 sock 配对记忆。

examples.en: I think housework is important.
Think before you water the plant.
examples.zh: 给植物浇水前先想一想。

examples.en: Do you think the floor is dirty?

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：think 音近「辛克」，辛克 think 想一想。
语义联想：把「想」和英文 think 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 thinks；过去式 thought

examples.en: Those socks are dirty.
Put those clothes in the box.
examples.zh: 把那些衣服放进盒子里。

examples.en: Those plants need water.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Those socks are dirty. those 是那些。

examples.en: Clean the toilet, please.
The toilet is in the bathroom.
Wash your hands after using the toilet.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 clean toilet 打扫卫生间。

examples.en: Put the dirty clothes in the washing machine.
The washing machine is in the bathroom.
Turn on the washing machine.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：washing 洗 + machine 机器，washing machine 是洗衣机。

examples.en: Water the plant, please.
The plant needs water every day.
Do not water the floor.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：water 音近「沃特」，沃特 water 浇水。
语义联想：把「浇水」和英文 water 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 waters；过去式 watered（作「浇水」讲）

examples.en: I am a fan of basketball.
She is a big fan of our school team.
examples.zh: 她是我们校队的铁杆粉丝。

examples.en: A fan cheers for the team.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 fan 球迷 cheer 为 team 加油。

examples.en: I get to school at seven thirty.
How do you get to school?
We walk to get to school.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：get 到达 + to school 到学校，get to school 是到达学校。

examples.en: It is half past seven.
Half an hour later, we get to school.
examples.zh: 半小时后，我们到达学校。

examples.en: I read for half an hour last night.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：It is half past seven. half 是一半。

examples.en: School starts in one hour.
We study for one hour every day.
An hour has sixty minutes.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：hour 音近「阿儿」，阿儿等 hour 一小时。
语义联想：把「小时」和英文 hour 配对记忆。

examples.en: Last week we had a sports game.
examples.zh: 上周我们进行了体育比赛。

examples.en: Who was the last to get to school?
This is the last seat in the row.
examples.zh: 这是这排最后一个座位。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Last week we had a game. last 是上一个。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级不存在；last night 固定搭配

examples.en: I did my homework last night.
Last night I went to bed late.
We watched the moon last night.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：last 上一个 + night 夜晚，last night 是昨晚。

examples.en: The little boy walks to school.
There is little time left.
She has a little dog.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The little boy walks to school. little 是小的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 less；最高级 least

examples.en: It is ten past eight.
Walk past the school gate.
Half past seven. Time for school.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：It is ten past eight. past 是经过、过去。

examples.en: Take a seat, please.
This is my seat in class.
The seat is near the window.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 take a seat 在 classroom 里坐下。

examples.en: I walk to school every day.
We walk past the park.
Walk quickly, or you will be late.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：walk 音近「沃克」，沃克 walk 步行。
语义联想：把「步行」和英文 walk 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 walks；过去式 walked

examples.en: Thanksgiving is an American holiday.
She has an American friend.
We learn about American food today.
examples.zh: 今天我们了解美国食物。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Thanksgiving is an American holiday. American 是美国的。

examples.en: I hope you feel better soon.
This soup tastes better than that one.
Good luck and better wishes!

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I hope you feel better. better 是更好的。

reveal.inflectionNote: good/well 的比较级

examples.en: We eat corn on Thanksgiving.
The corn is sweet and yellow.
Help yourselves to some corn.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：corn 音近「考恩」，考恩吃 corn 玉米。
语义联想：把「玉米」和英文 corn 配对记忆。

examples.en: Help yourselves to the soup.
The food is ready. Help yourselves!
Help yourselves to some corn and salad.
examples.zh: 请随便吃些玉米和色拉。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：help 帮助 + yourselves 你们自己，help yourselves 是请自便。

examples.en: I hope you can join us.
We hope you have good luck.
I hope the soup is delicious.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：hope 音近「厚普」，厚普 hope 希望。
语义联想：把「希望」和英文 hope 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 hopes；过去式 hoped

examples.en: We invite you to Thanksgiving dinner.
examples.zh: 我们邀请您参加感恩节晚餐。

examples.en: She can invite her friend to join.
Thank you for the invite.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：invite 音近「因外特」，因外特 invite 邀请。
语义联想：把「邀请」和英文 invite 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 invites；过去式 invited

examples.en: Join us for Thanksgiving dinner.
examples.zh: 来参加我们的感恩节晚餐吧。

examples.en: Would you like to join us?
Many friends join the party.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：join 音近「卓因」，卓因 join 加入。
语义联想：把「参加」和英文 join 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 joins；过去式 joined

examples.en: Good luck to you!
I wish you good luck.
Better luck next time.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：luck 音近「拉克」，拉克 wish luck 祝好运。
语义联想：把「运气」和英文 luck 配对记忆。

examples.en: The soup is hot and delicious.
Help yourselves to some soup.
We have corn soup for dinner.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：soup 音近「苏普」，苏普喝 soup 汤。
语义联想：把「汤」和英文 soup 配对记忆。

examples.en: Happy Thanksgiving!
We have a big dinner on Thanksgiving.
Thanksgiving is in November in America.
examples.zh: 美国的感恩节在十一月。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 Thanksgiving 晚餐吃 corn 玉米和 soup 汤。

examples.en: Help yourselves to the food.
Enjoy yourselves at the party.
Make yourselves at home.
examples.zh: 别客气，就像在自己家一样。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Help yourselves to the food. yourselves 是你们自己。

examples.en: I like the moon because it is beautiful.
examples.zh: 我喜欢月亮因为它很美。

examples.en: We stay home because it is raining.
examples.zh: 我们待在家里因为在下雨。

examples.en: The earth goes around the sun because of gravity.
examples.zh: 地球绕太阳转是因为引力。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：because 音近「比考斯」，比考斯说 because 因为。
语义联想：把「因为」和英文 because 配对记忆。

examples.en: The earth goes around the sun.
We live on the earth.
The earth looks blue from space.
examples.zh: 从太空看地球是蓝色的。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：earth 音近「厄斯」，厄斯 live on earth 住在地球。
语义联想：把「地球」和英文 earth 配对记忆。

examples.en: We watch the moon in the evening.
The Mid-Autumn Festival is in the evening.
Good evening, everyone!

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：evening 音近「伊文宁」，伊文宁在 evening 晚上。
语义联想：把「晚上」和英文 evening 配对记忆。

examples.en: The moon goes around the earth.
The earth goes around the sun.
How long does it take to go around?

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：go 走 + around 环绕，go around 是绕着……转。

examples.en: The moon has its own light? No, it shines.
examples.zh: 月亮有自己的光吗？不，它反射光。

examples.en: The earth goes around the sun on its path.
examples.zh: 地球沿着轨道绕太阳转。

examples.en: The sun and its light give us warmth.
examples.zh: 太阳和它的光给我们带来温暖。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The moon has its light. its 是它的。

examples.en: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival!
We eat mooncakes on the Mid-Autumn Festival.
The Mid-Autumn Festival is in autumn.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Mid 中间 + Autumn 秋 + Festival 节，Mid-Autumn Festival 是中秋节。

examples.en: The moon is bright tonight.
We watch the moon on Mid-Autumn Festival.
The moon goes around the earth.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：moon 音近「穆恩」，穆恩看 moon 月亮。
形象联想：想象 moon 在 evening 夜空中 shine 发光。

examples.en: Is the story real?
The moon is a real place in space.
examples.zh: 月亮是太空中真实存在的地方。

examples.en: This is a real Mid-Autumn Festival.
examples.zh: 这是一个真正的中秋节。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Is the story real? real 是真实的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 realer/more real；最高级 realest/most real

examples.en: The moon can shine in the evening sky.
The sun can shine during the day.
Stars shine at night.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：shine 音近「晒恩」，晒恩看 shine 发光。
语义联想：把「发光」和英文 shine 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 shines；过去式 shone

examples.en: The sun is very hot.
The earth goes around the sun.
The sun shines in the morning.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：sun 音近「桑」，桑看 sun 太阳。
形象联想：想象 sun 照耀，earth 绕 sun 转。
